description.zh:
已接入的资源ID，云产品接入时由WAF自动生成。

> 您可以通过[CreateCloudResource](~~2839876~~)接入资源后，查看响应中的资源ID。
description.en:
The ID of the connected resource, which is automatically generated by WAF when the resource is connected in cloud native mode.

> You can call the [CreateCloudResource](~~2839876~~) operation to connect a resource and then view the resource ID in the response.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

title.zh: 删除云产品的扩展证书
title.en: Delete an extension certificate for a cloud service

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi delete-cloud-resource-extension-cert --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --instance-id waf_v3prepay_public_intl-sg-000 --cloud-resource-id lb-bp000000000k5uj2p-443-clb7 --cert-id 123-cn-hangzhou --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
